tools.name: browser_fetch_webpage
tools.description: Load any URL and return its content using a real browser with full JavaScript execution. Use whenever a webpage needs to be loaded — whether to read content, interact with a web app, or access any HTTP/HTTPS resource. Connects to the user's existing browser session with all cookies, logins, and SSO sessions available automatically. Handles JavaScript rendering, authentication, and anti-bot protection. Prefer this over generic HTTP fetch for authenticated or JS-heavy pages.

browser.description: Browser to use. Uses CDP to connect to the user's existing browser session.

removeUnnecessaryHTML.description: Remove Unnecessary HTML for size reduction by 90%.

selector.description: CSS selector to extract a specific DOM subtree instead of the full page. Use to scope extraction and reduce response size (e.g., 'main', '[role="main"]', 'body > div:first-child'). If no elements match, falls back to full page with a note.

postLoadWait.description: Additional milliseconds to wait after page load before extracting HTML. Use for pages that need extra time to render. Default: 0 (no extra wait, SPA detection handles most cases automatically).

detectForms.description: Scan page for forms and return structured form data (fields, selectors, submit buttons, orphaned inputs). Set to true when you need to fill or interact with forms.

tools.name: browser_execute_javascript
tools.description: Run JavaScript on a browser-loaded page and get the result. Use when: you need to extract structured data from a page, manipulate the DOM, read page state, run custom queries on page content, or perform UI actions that CSS selectors cannot reach. Returns the script result as JSON, text, or void. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

script.description: JavaScript source code to execute in page context

tools.name: browser_click_element
tools.description: Click buttons, links, or any element on a browser-loaded page. Use when: you need to navigate a website, submit a form, press a button, follow a link, or interact with any clickable UI element. Targets by CSS selector or visible text. Returns updated page HTML after click. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., '#submit-btn', '.login-button')

text.description: Text content to search for if selector is not provided (e.g., 'Sign In', 'Submit')

waitForElementTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for element in milliseconds

returnHtml.description: Whether to wait for stability and return HTML after clicking. Set to false for fast form interactions (checkboxes, radio buttons).

removeUnnecessaryHTML.description: Remove Unnecessary HTML for size reduction by 90%. Only used when returnHtml is true.

postClickWait.description: Milliseconds to wait after click for SPAs to render dynamic content.

detectForms.description: Scan page for forms after click and return structured form data (fields, selectors, submit buttons, orphaned inputs). Only applies when returnHtml=true. Set to true when you need to fill or interact with forms after clicking.

tools.name: browser_type_text
tools.description: Type text into input fields on a browser-loaded page. Use when: you need to fill a form, enter a search query, type into a text box, or input data into any editable field. Supports filling multiple fields in a single call. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

fields.description: Array of fields to fill. Each field specifies a selector and text to type.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input element (e.g., '#username', 'input[name="email"]')

text.description: Text to type into the field

clear.description: Whether to clear existing text first

waitForElementTimeout.description: Maximum time to wait for element in milliseconds

returnHtml.description: Whether to wait for stability and return HTML after typing.

removeUnnecessaryHTML.description: Remove Unnecessary HTML for size reduction by 90%. Only used when returnHtml is true.

postTypeWait.description: Milliseconds to wait after typing for SPAs to render dynamic content.

tools.name: browser_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab to free resources. Use when: you are done with a page and want to release memory, or need to reset session state for a hostname. Uses exact hostname match.

url.description: The URL whose hostname tab should be closed

tools.name: browser_get_current_html
tools.description: Re-read HTML from an already-loaded page without reloading it. Use when: you need to check page state after a click or form fill, re-extract content from the current page, or get updated HTML after dynamic changes. Much faster than browser_fetch_webpage since it skips navigation. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

removeUnnecessaryHTML.description: Remove Unnecessary HTML for size reduction by 90%.

selector.description: CSS selector to extract a specific DOM subtree instead of the full page. Use to scope extraction and reduce response size (e.g., 'main', '[role="main"]', 'body > div:first-child'). If no elements match, falls back to full page with a note.

detectForms.description: Scan page for forms and return structured form data (fields, selectors, submit buttons, orphaned inputs). Set to true when you need to fill or interact with forms.

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of a browser-loaded page as PNG. Use when: you need to see what a page looks like, analyze visual layout, view charts/images/graphs, debug UI issues, or when HTML alone is insufficient to understand the page content. Returns base64-encoded PNG. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Default: false (viewport only).

tools.name: browser_scroll_page
tools.description: Scroll within a browser-loaded page. Use when: you need to see more content below the fold, bring an element into view before clicking, scroll to a specific section, or navigate long pages. Supports scroll by direction, to a CSS selector, or to absolute coordinates. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: The URL of the page (must match a previously fetched page)

direction.description: Direction to scroll. Use with 'amount' parameter.

amount.description: Pixels to scroll in the specified direction. Default: 500 (roughly half a viewport).

selector.description: CSS selector of element to scroll into view. When provided, ignores direction/amount and scrolls until the element is visible.

x.description: Absolute horizontal scroll position. Use with 'y' for precise positioning.

y.description: Absolute vertical scroll position. Use with 'x' for precise positioning.

tools.name: browser_navigate_history
tools.description: Go back or forward in browser history. Use when: you clicked a link and need to return to the previous page, or want to go forward after going back. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

url.description: URL of the already-loaded page (identifies which tab to navigate)

direction.description: Navigation direction: 'back' to go to previous page, 'forward' to go to next page

removeUnnecessaryHTML.description: Remove unnecessary HTML elements (scripts, styles, etc.) for size reduction.

tools.name: browser_detect_forms
tools.description: Scan a browser-loaded page and return all forms as structured JSON — fields, types, validation rules, submit buttons, and orphaned inputs. Use when: you need to understand a form before filling it, discover what fields exist on a page, or map form structure for automation. PREREQUISITE: Page must be loaded with browser_fetch_webpage first.

includeHidden.description: Include hidden fields (type=hidden). Useful for understanding form state.
